label: Hikvision Face Capture (HCNetSDK)
_comment: Hikvision publishes the full HCNetSDK on hikvision.com/en/download under 'Developer / SDK' — it is a large zip gated by an EULA click-through, so it is intentionally NOT vendored into this repo. Install the SDK (or copy its bin folder) to enrollment-bridge\sdk\ or set SDK_DIR; sdkManager already searches C:\Program Files\Hikvision. This manifest only needs to be enabled if you want face-frame capture through the bridge instead of ISAPI (the server-side 'isapi' driver covers most Hikvision terminals without any DLL).
